items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I started to say O’Hara, that wasn’t his name.

ctx.x: What was his name, the surgeon’s name?
Uh, what was his name? I started to say O’Hara, that wasn’t his name. I’ll figure it out.

It’ll come back to you. Just to loop back on a couple of things that you brought up, we will jump around but I don’t want to loose this thought, who was in the personnel with Yusef? Who was in the personnel in the group with Yusef? What was the personnel in that group?
